test: R-32 new-product onboarding entirely through the API (run 2026-11-02, local backend)
data: real MVTec AD wood images used as an unseen product 'onboard_panel': 80 fit-split goods + 25 train-split defects as samples; 12 test-split images inspected afterwards
limitation: Holdout has only 5 defective images; the 1.0 scores are not a reliable estimate. New products get anomaly detection; supervised class labels need retraining YOLO-seg with labelled masks (ml/train_yolo_seg.py), which is not automated.
